phase: blind original-pixel first estimates preserved before reading any annotation labels or predictions
coordinate_convention: Original image integer pixels, x rightward and y downward; plausible regions are inclusive [xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax]. Representative points are visual estimates, not subpixel ground truth.
target: Actual visible lower-front corner/rounded turn of white cassette fronts, not upper projecting lip, rack, extrapolated sharp corner, or brightest stripe.
processing: Crops of original unmarked RGB pixels and nearest-neighbor scaling only; no enhancement or model output.
